admissible_source_evidence.variant_a:
Request record: adding a second weekly check-in

On the second the member asked for a second weekly check-in, to fall on Thursdays. The steward decided the request on the third, using the decision power that standing rule 3 of the Wing's rulebook gives to stewards. Outcome: approved, starting the following week. The member can withdraw the request at any point before it starts.
